compiled_state.title: [REVIEW-WORKFLOW]: dso:code-reviewer-* not registered as Agent subagent_type -> reviews dispatch as general-purpose with verbatim agent body
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 4f939b9343359250407aaa5404964e82a6a0fe1f
* **Active workflow:** /dso:fix-bug Phase H Step 1 -> COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 5 -> REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4
* **Plugin version:** dso-dev v1.16.11
* **Available agent types this session** (from system prompt): claude-code-guide, Explore, general-purpose, Plan, statusline-setup

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4 explicitly directs:

> \"Use the registered subagent_type directly — `dso:code-reviewer-*` are valid Agent tool subagent_type values in this environment. Do NOT substitute `subagent_type: 'general-purpose'` with a constructed prompt.\"

The named agents `dso:code-reviewer-light`, `dso:code-reviewer-standard`, `dso:code-reviewer-deep-correctness`, `dso:code-reviewer-deep-verification`, `dso:code-reviewer-deep-hygiene`, `dso:code-reviewer-deep-arch`, `dso:code-reviewer-test-quality`, `dso:code-reviewer-security-red-team`, `dso:code-reviewer-security-blue-team`, and `dso:code-reviewer-performance` should be present in the Agent tool's available subagent_type list so dispatches can use them directly. The agent files exist on disk at `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md` (verified — 10 files).

#### Actual Behavior

The runtime's registered subagent_type list at the start of this session contains only: `claude-code-guide`, `Explore`, `general-purpose`, `Plan`, `statusline-setup`. None of the `dso:code-reviewer-*` agents are registered. CLAUDE.md says to fall back to `general-purpose` with the agent file body inlined verbatim when the named type is unavailable; that fallback is what this session has been using for every review dispatch (including the standard-tier review and test-quality overlay just run for cb67-2265).

Consequence: the dispatch loses the dedicated agent's frontmatter (model, color, runtime hooks), the operator must inline ~600 lines of agent body into every prompt (token cost ~3K per dispatch), and the runtime cannot enforce per-agent permissions or instrument per-agent telemetry separately from generic dispatches.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4 dispatched the standard-tier reviewer
  * REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4 dispatched the test-quality overlay reviewer (parallel)
* **Raw Results:**
  * Both Agent tool calls used `subagent_type: \"general-purpose\"` because `dso:code-reviewer-standard` and `dso:code-reviewer-test-quality` were not in the available subagent_type list
  * The verbatim agent body was inlined in each prompt (~600 lines × 2 = ~1200 lines of duplicated agent guidance per review pass)
* **Known Workarounds:** Inline the agent file body verbatim per CLAUDE.md fallback rule. This works but inflates prompt size and breaks per-agent telemetry.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* /dso:review (REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 4 — Dispatch Code Review Sub-Agent)
* Affected files: `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md` (10 agent definitions exist; none registered as subagent_type)
* Plugin marketplace registration: `plugins/dso/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` and `plugin.json` (likely missing the agent-registration manifest entries)

### 6. Logs

```
$ ls plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-*.md | wc -l
10

# Available subagent types (from session system prompt):
#   claude-code-guide, Explore, general-purpose, Plan, statusline-setup
# Missing: all 10 dso:code-reviewer-* agents
```

#### Suggested fix scope

Investigate the plugin's agent-registration mechanism. The agent .md files exist with proper frontmatter (`name:`, `model:`, `description:`); the runtime should be discovering them. Likely the plugin manifest needs an explicit agents section or the agent files need a different location/extension to be picked up by the Claude Code plugin loader. Verify by inspecting plugin.json and the marketplace.json schema for an `agents` field.
